currencyNote: Costs are gameplay estimates in 2026 USD millions, not NASA procurement prices.

items.name: Orion-class Crew Capsule
items.note: Orion accommodates four crew for up to 21 days. Mass is a gameplay architecture value.

items.name: Deep-space Transit Habitat
items.note: Concept module; mass and power are transparent gameplay estimates.

items.name: Mars Descent / Ascent Vehicle
items.note: Concept vehicle based on Mars architecture functions, not a flight design.

items.name: COPV Oxygen Reserve
items.note: Composite pressure vessels are used for spacecraft gases; capacity and dry mass are estimates.

items.name: COPV Oxygen Bank
items.note: Four isolated vessels reduce common-mode loss; figures are estimates.

items.name: Water Electrolysis O₂ Generator
items.note: Splits water to oxygen; capacity, mass and power are gameplay engineering estimates.

items.name: Regenerative CO₂ Scrubber
items.note: Required to control cabin carbon dioxide; game figures are estimates.

items.name: Water Recovery Assembly
items.note: Recovery percentage is a system target; mass/power/cost are gameplay estimates.

items.name: Potable Water Tank
items.note: Water inventory is exact for game; tank mass and cost are estimates.

items.name: Shelf-stable Food Pack
items.note: Uses 3,035 kcal crew-day requirement and packaged-food mission estimates.

items.name: Long-duration Food Pack
items.note: Shelf-stable food; variety and nutrient degradation remain mission risks.

items.name: Cryogenic Oxygen Tank
items.note: DRA-scale oxygen quantity; tank dry mass and cryocooling power are gameplay estimates.

items.name: Cryogenic Methane Tank
items.note: Methane quantity, tank mass and cost are architecture gameplay estimates.

items.name: MOXIE Heritage Unit
items.note: Technology demonstrator; far too small for crew or ascent oxygen production.

items.name: Crew-scale O₂ ISRU Plant
items.note: Target lies in NASA's published 2.2–3.5 kg/hour architecture range; mass/power/cost are estimates.

items.name: Deployable Solar / Battery Field
items.note: Dust and latitude reduce output; mass based on a NASA point study, cost is estimated.

items.name: Fission Surface Power System
items.note: NASA selected fission as primary Mars surface power; mass is study-derived, cost estimated.

items.name: Pressurized Exploration Rover
items.note: Concept rover; all numeric specifications are gameplay estimates.

items.name: Mars Surface Habitat
items.note: 15 kW critical-load reference; mass and cost are estimates.

items.name: Storm Shelter Kit
items.note: Uses existing low-mass stowage around crew; geometry and mass are game abstractions.

items.name: Exploration Medical System
items.note: Capability bundle; details and cost are gameplay abstractions.
